reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves all eight handed-off need records, maps exact need text to the six supplied capabilities, and leaves the two needs with no matching capability as unsupported. No generic keyword matching or unrelated candidate mapping is visible.

The produced priority table matches the assigned output, with n06-r01 and n06-r07 first because they are unsupported.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: unsupported needs remain visible rather than being hidden
